findings.title: Assert resolved rows remain visible for confirmation
findings.why_it_matters: The exceptions-filter test applies a correction and immediately changes the filter. It would still pass if the worker stopped retaining just-resolved rows, leaving operators unable to inspect the corrected value and original provenance in their current exception review.
evidence: tests/e2e/correction-reupload.spec.ts:104-106: The source filter is exceptions, then record 3 is corrected before the filter changes.
src/processing.worker.ts:40:     : run.rows.filter(r => retained.has(r.id) || (sourceQuery.filter === "invalid" ? r.status === "invalid" : r.issues.length)).map(r => sourceRowsById.get(r.id)!);
findings.suggested_fix: Before switching back to All at line 107, assert that record 3 remains in the exceptions source table after Apply and displays both its corrected value and `Original: Bad`; then keep the existing assertion that it disappears after explicitly changing the filter.

findings.title: Exercise warning-only rows in source exception filters
findings.why_it_matters: All exercised source-filter examples have invalid rows. An implementation that treats Rows with exceptions as Invalid rows only would satisfy the current assertions but hide warning-only records, contrary to the new independent-filter contract.
evidence: tests/e2e/correction-reupload.spec.ts:100-101: The fixture has bad numeric operands, making its exception rows invalid.
src/processing.worker.ts:40:     : run.rows.filter(r => retained.has(r.id) || (sourceQuery.filter === "invalid" ? r.status === "invalid" : r.issues.length)).map(r => sourceRowsById.get(r.id)!);
findings.suggested_fix: Add a browser case with a warning-only source row, such as a formula-like text value copied to output. Assert it appears under Rows with exceptions with its source identity and warning marker, and disappears under Invalid rows only while full-dataset counts remain unchanged.
